name: find-words
description:
Whole words of a phrase equal to the items of a list, compared in any case and with ё as е.

items: the words to find.
mode: "any" — any of the words; "all" — only phrases holding every one of them.
where: "anywhere", "start" (the first word only) or "end" (the last word only).
ignore_punct: punctuation at the edges of a word does not count («диван,» is «диван»).

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "кресло" find-words диван write -
-> купить диван, true; кресло, false

lemmas: compare the lemmas of the words (the bundled dictionary): «дешевые диваны» is «дешевый диван».

find-words marks the rows where the matcher finds something, in a new column <column>_find of true and false.

options.name: --items
options.description: the words to find. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --mode
options.description: "any" — any of the words; "all" — only phrases holding every one of them.

options.name: --where
options.description: "anywhere", "start" (the first word only) or "end" (the last word only).

options.name: --ignore-punct
options.description: punctuation at the edges of a word does not count («диван,» is «диван»).

options.name: --lemmas
options.description: compare the lemmas of the words (the bundled dictionary): «дешевые диваны» is «дешевый диван».

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: ITEMS
arguments.description: the words to find. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list. The same as --items ITEMS.
